name: Real-Time hub Get Started / Home Page Experience
description: To improve the onboarding experience for a broader range of users, we’re introducing a new Home Page experience within the Real Time hub. This update is designed to support both technical and non-technical users by offering a more intuitive, task-oriented entry point.The Home Page will be especially helpful for users who are new to the platform or do not yet have access to data streams or query tables. It will highlight key capabilities such as connecting to data sources, subscribing to real-time events, and exploring learning resources and case studies that demonstrate real-world applications.This enhancement aims to reduce friction, encourage exploration, and accelerate time-to-value for all users.
